verdict: A textbook outfit for someone who spends eighty percent of class deriving proofs and zero percent updating online grades.
detailedQuote: The earth-tone palette suggests a man who optimized his wardrobe for minimum laundry effort. It delivers peak strict midterm grader energy with zero room for partial credit.
